summary.text: Rick Scarbrough, listed by Ballotpedia as Richard Scarbrough, is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 33 since November 5, 2024, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Richard Scarbrough earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Tusculum College, and his career experience includes working in law enforcement.
He succeeded John Ragan in the District 33 seat.
